text:
IncidentBot: PagerDuty INC-2026 fired -> redis-prod-west: maxclients exceeded on redis-prod-3. Severity: P1. Affected: inference-api (/v1/generate) experiencing 502/504s and elevated latencies. Alert: https://pagerduty.example/INC-2026 :rotating_light:
PagerDuty: Notification: incident triggered and routed to #eng-oncall. Paging Alex (primary).
Alex: acked via PD. I'm on call. jumping in. Currently seeing > 95% clients used on redis-prod-3. 503 spikes started ~2469123580.
Alex: checking dashboards... api latency spike lines up with redis timeouts and pgbouncer wait queue growth.
Alex: quick check: `redis-cli -h redis-prod-3 INFO clients | grep connected_clients` -> shows 10,250 (maxclients=10k)
Nina: looking at pgbouncer metrics now, there is a short burst of new DB connections from inference workers. Wait queue ~1200. Pg write latency spiking.
Eli: I can scale redis replicas and bump pod limits, but adding replicas won't change maxclients on the single instance. We should failover/shift traffic to redis-prod-1/2 while we increase maxclients and add capacity.
Priya: can we route a portion of traffic to dedicated cold path (generate-cold) to reduce pressure? If we apply temporary rate-limit at the edge, that will buy time.
Alex: doing triage: 1) shift read traffic off redis-prod-3, 2) increase redis maxclients (on-disk conf) and restart, 3) scale pgbouncer and PG read replicas. Will coordinate.
Alex: running quick command to mark redis-prod-3 as standby in our HAProxy pool: `curl -X POST https://infra-api/proxy/drain/redis-prod-3 -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'`
IncidentBot: infra-api started drain job for redis-prod-3. Expected connection drain ~30s.
Nina: meanwhile I'm increasing pgbouncer pool to 700 and adjusting `max_client_conn` to 5000 on the pgbouncer cluster for inference namespace. Patch rolling now: `kubectl -n infra set configmap pgbouncer-config --from-file=pgbouncer.ini`
Eli: spun up 2 extra redis instances (redis-prod-5, redis-prod-6) and added to cluster. Also increasing instance memory and net threads.
Alex: increasing redis `maxclients` from 10000 -> 20000 on redis-prod-3 to allow immediate headroom. Command: `redis-cli CONFIG SET maxclients 20000` (will persist after conf update). Doing now.
Alex: `CONFIG SET` returned OK. Monitoring client count... currently 10.3k and dropping as connections drain.
Priya: rolling a temporary 30% rate-limit on /v1/generate to protect backend. Applying gateway config: `gatewayctl set-rate-limit inference-api 30% --scope prod`
Alex: monitoring error rate: 502s tailing off. pgbouncer wait queue dropping from 1200 -> 200 over the last 2min.
Nina: PG replica read buffer increased, one replica was CPU-starved; scaled xc-read-01 -> 2x. That reduced db wait time for inference metadata lookups.
PagerDuty: INC-2026 acknowledged by Alex at 2469123620.
Alex: summary so far: drained redis-prod-3, increased maxclients, added redis nodes, scaled pgbouncer + PG replicas, applied rate-limiter. Latency back to baseline for most requests, error rate from 8% -> 0.6%.
Priya: posting a short customer-facing note to status page draft: "We experienced elevated errors for generation endpoints in prod-west between ~08:26-08:32 UTC due to cache and DB connection exhaustion. Mitigations applied; service restored. Investigation ongoing." Anyone object? :eyes:
Eli: LGTM. Add note that no data loss expected.
Nina: running a quick health check query across app fleet to ensure no lingering blocked clients. `SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state='idle in transaction'` -> low.
Alex: rebalancing traffic back to normal. Removing temporary rate-limit in 10m if metrics stable.
Priya: can we run a quick canary to ensure the inference throughput handles the ramp? Alex, please keep watch for 15m.
Alex: will monitor. Setting an alert window and will handoff after stabilization.
IncidentBot: Incident INC-2026 marked as resolved at 2469123720 by Alex.
Alex: resolving PD and scheduling postmortem. Root cause hypothesis: sudden client flood from a model rollout that increased connection churn + cache miss storm -> hit redis maxclients -> backpressure cascaded to pgbouncer/PG.
Priya: scheduling postmortem for tomorrow 16:00 UTC. Action items: (1) add autoscaling for redis maxclients/threads, (2) enforce client-side connection pooling + backpressure, (3) add runbook step to temporarily divert traffic and increase maxclients, (4) add alert for pgbouncer wait queue > 200.
Eli: I'll follow up on infra capacity and add runbook snippet for safe `CONFIG SET` and restart procedure.
Nina: I'll prepare DB-side mitigation doc for pgbouncer tuning and connection leak checks.
Alex: handing off to Priya for watch. @Priya you're up for the next 30m.
Priya: taking handoff. Thanks team. I'll close the PD once postmortem ticket is created. :white_check_mark:
